text: Embrace a tree as your ancient ancestor. Approach the tree, feel its bark, its strength, its calm. Embrace it, pressing your whole body to it, and imagine that you are exchanging something intangible with it - like two infinities. Through you and the tree, all godlike humanity communicates, manifesting a bouquet of its most beautiful states. And through the tree, Mother Nature manifests with the entire history of evolution and the diversity of life. Breathe and unite in love. At some point you will feel God - at that end, and Life - at this end. Two infinities will merge into one, and it will be unclear where the boundary lies between you and the tree, if it exists at all.
